Header.title: Reza Salehi
Header.paragraph: Full-stack specialist with a strong frontend focus—including deep Angular experience (RxJS, NgRx, Signals, Reactive Forms)—building polished web and app experiences.

About.paragraph: Self-taught web and mobile programmer with {{years}} years of professional experience across product companies and remote teams. Strong Angular and modern frontend skills (RxJS, NgRx, Signals, Reactive Forms, DI, Router), plus React/Vue and full-stack delivery. Excellent teamwork, communication, and timeline ownership—passionate about learning and new opportunities.

highlights: Spearheaded unified merchant workflows across responsive web and mobile applications (Angular, React, Vue, Nuxt.js, React Native, NestJS, Django), accelerating cross-client release velocity from 3 weeks down to 9 days.
Built and maintained Angular merchant surfaces with Reactive Forms, Angular Router, and Dependency Injection, aligning feature delivery with React/Vue/Nuxt client apps under a shared product roadmap.
Refactored high-concurrency order dispatch and payment processing pipelines, achieving a 38% reduction in API response latency and maintaining 99.95% transaction success during peak traffic.

Architected a multi-brand component design system and unified state management (NgRx/RxJS on Angular, Zustand and RTK Query on React), ensuring synchronized real-time data across 3 separate merchant touchpoints.

Developed high-availability full-stack capabilities across 5 distinct business verticals, including live audio/video streaming and interactive collaboration suites, working in Agile/Scrum ceremonies with iterative sprint delivery.
Constructed asynchronous microservices powered by Node.js, NestJS, and Redis pub/sub queues, handling 100k+ concurrent WebSocket connections with zero downtime.
Integrated WebRTC media protocols into responsive dashboards (including Angular and React clients), reducing packet loss and audio latency by 22% for distributed enterprise video rooms.

Overhauled enterprise Angular application architecture with lazy-loaded Angular Router modules, Dependency Injection patterns, and standalone/feature boundaries—elevating Core Web Vitals, shrinking initial bundle size by 28%, and lowering bounce rates by 15%.

Delivered complex domain workflows with Angular Reactive Forms, template-driven form migration paths, and validation pipelines, while coordinating Agile sprints, backlog grooming, and iterative release planning with cross-functional stakeholders.

Implemented scalable client state and async data flows with RxJS operators, NgRx store/effects, and Angular Signals where appropriate, eliminating redundant HTTP round-trips and lifting checkout conversion by 18%.
Automated continuous integration and deployment with GitHub Actions and Docker, raising team release velocity and deployment frequency by 50% within Agile delivery cycles.
Crafted scalable frontend architectures for 10+ client applications across social networking, marketplace commerce, and virtual meeting productivity tools.
Published an internal reusable component library featuring 50+ accessible React and React Native primitives, curtailing multi-project feature build time by 30%.
Engineered resilient client-side authentication and state synchronization via Redux Toolkit, providing sub-100ms UI responsiveness across constrained network connections.
Directed a distributed engineering squad of 12 developers, governing architectural standards, pull-request quality gates, and agile sprint delivery for generative AI builder platforms.
Pioneered real-time streaming interfaces for generative AI application customization with React, WebSockets, and Tailwind CSS, driving a 60% increase in weekly active user retention.
Formulated automated regression testing pipelines and real-time telemetry utilizing Jest and Sentry, curbing production bug escapes by 42%.
Spearheaded full-stack development of client web portals and Progressive Web Applications (PWA) using React, Next.js, and Node.js REST services, elevating active task completion rates by 28%.
Engineered Next.js server-side rendering (SSR) and Service Worker asset caching architectures, reducing First Contentful Paint (FCP) by 45% and elevating 30-day user retention by 20%.
Architected high-throughput MongoDB aggregation pipelines and indexing models, cutting database query execution latency by 38% across 15,000+ active mobile user accounts.

Engineered 12+ bespoke client web applications and responsive e-commerce storefronts using JavaScript, HTML5/SCSS, Node.js, and MySQL, achieving a 100% on-time project completion rate and a 5.0/5.0 client satisfaction rating.
Constructed reusable UI component templates and standardized cross-browser workflows, reducing subsequent client maintenance tickets by 35% and accelerating page load speeds by 25%.
Implemented structured SEO schemas and semantic DOM architectures across client landing pages, driving a 40% average increase in organic search traffic within 90 days of launch.
